**Finding: compliant (GOVLAW — preferred position met).**

- § 28.1 — New York law governs the Agreement (plus CISG exclusion, which is neutral-to-favourable for us).
- § 28.2 — exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with irrevocable submission and waiver of venue/forum non conveniens objections; the carve-out for interim injunctive relief elsewhere is mutual and standard.
- No arbitration provision, foreign seat, or competing governing-law clause exists anywhere in the document.
- § 28.3's pre-filing executive meeting (15 business days) is a minor procedural step only; it expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings and carries no fee-shifting, so it is noted rather than redlined.

No redline proposed.
